sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: Higher logarithm functions are of fundamental importance in many areas of both physics and mathematics, and the dilogarithm function $\operatorname{Li}_{2}$ may be seen as the most basic and fundamental function of this form. Polylogarithms arise in deep areas of number theory and quantum theory, and the study of higher logarithm functions in its own right provides one of the core topics concerning special
